hotels.title: Five-Star Hyatt Regency Dubai Luxury in Historic Deira with Dazzling Skyline Views
hotels.description: Overlooking Deira Corniche on Dubai Creek, this polished five-star retreat places you moments from the Gold Souk, Spice Souk and the heritage lanes of Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood. A complimentary shuttle links guests to Al Mamzar Beach Park and key shopping districts, adding ease to days in the city. Inside, 16 restaurants and bars span Japanese at Miyako, Persian specialities at Shahrzad and skyline drinks at the revolving Al Dawaar. There is also an outdoor pool, a fitness centre and a spa, with Union Metro Station nearby for direct access to Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa
